description:
Build, share and track unlimited lessons. Quizzing and Surveys. Insights and Reporting. Client Experience Manager. Learning Library. Advanced Lesson Collaboration. Ask the Expert. User Management with Smart groups. User roles and permissions. Single Sign On. Automation. Custom Branding.
Lessonly acquired by Seismic

labeler_proposal.rationale: Lists lesson building, quizzing, surveys, reporting, user management, roles, SSO, and branding. These are conventional learning-management features, and no AI capability is described.
evidence_spans: Build, share and track unlimited lessons. Quizzing and Surveys. Insights and Reporting.
User Management with Smart groups. User roles and permissions. Single Sign On.

blind_proposal.rationale: The description lists conventional lesson authoring, quizzing, reporting, user management, permissions, and automation.
evidence_spans: Build, share and track unlimited lessons.

integration_concern: Description includes “Smart groups” but neither proposal explains what it means. Assess whether this is merely conventional grouping or an unresolved potential AI cue; do not infer implementation.

description: Apttus' Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) solution ends the era of manual and disjointed contract processes and enables you to deliver higher-quality customer experiences through automation and increased visibility. Apttus Intelligent Workflow Approvals (IWA) enables users to set up approvals on pricing, discounting, promotions, contract terms, agreement clauses, and more. Now a Conga Company.

labeler_proposal.rationale: Describes contract lifecycle management with user-configured approval rules on pricing, discounts, and terms. The word 'Intelligent' appears only in a product name and is not explained, so the non-AI reading is weak.
evidence_spans: Intelligent Workflow Approvals (IWA) enables users to set up approvals on pricing, discounting, promotions, contract terms, agreement clauses, and more

blind_proposal.rationale: The description identifies conventional contract lifecycle management and workflow approvals.
evidence_spans: ends the era of manual and disjointed contract processes
